query:
SELECT s.id FROM discovery_sources s
        WHERE s.provenance IN ('peer','bundled') AND s.enabled AND s.id IS DISTINCT FROM $3
          AND s.created_at<clock_timestamp()-interval '24 hours'
          AND (s.cooldown_until IS NULL OR s.cooldown_until<=clock_timestamp())
          AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM discovery_sources child WHERE child.introduced_by=s.id)
          AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM discovery_jobs j WHERE
            (j.source_id=s.id AND (j.withdrawn OR j.leased_until>clock_timestamp()))
            OR (j.introduced_by=s.id AND j.source_id<>s.id))
          AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM discovery_entries e WHERE e.source_id=s.id AND
            (e.state<>'active' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM discovery_dismissals d WHERE d.entry_id=e.id)))
          AND ((SELECT count(*) FROM discovery_sources)>=$1
            OR ($3::bigint IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT count(*) FROM discovery_sources)>=(($1*4)/5))
            OR (SELECT count(*) FROM discovery_sources WHERE origin=$2)>=$4
            OR (SELECT count(*) FROM discovery_sources WHERE introduced_by IS NOT DISTINCT FROM $3)>=$5)
          AND ((SELECT count(*) FROM discovery_sources WHERE origin=$2)<$4 OR s.origin=$2)
          AND ((SELECT count(*) FROM discovery_sources WHERE introduced_by IS NOT DISTINCT FROM $3)<$5
            OR s.introduced_by IS NOT DISTINCT FROM $3)
        ORDER BY s.created_at,s.id LIMIT 1
